trialBlurb: New Worker and Employer plans start with 1 free week. Add your UK bank details to begin. After the week, the first month or year is charged unless you cancel. Cancelling keeps full access until the week ends.
trialActive: Free trial until {date}. {price} will be charged unless you cancel before then.

stripeNotConfigured: Stripe keys are not set. Add them to .env.local to enable payments. Use POST /api/dev/set-tier in development to simulate tiers.
